observations: Photo 0 is a promotional or stock image with a digital background and multiple watermarks ('GEEK MUSIC', 'PRESHORS PRODUCTS').
The brand 'YAMAHA' and model 'PSR E483' are overlaid in large text on the background.
The keyboard unit in the photo has 'PSR-E483' printed on the chassis above the right-hand keys.
The keyboard features 61 keys and a central LCD screen.
A graphic of a power adapter is visible in the bottom right corner.
The screen in the photo is illuminated, showing 'ConcertGrand' and other settings.

risks.risk: The image is a stock or marketing photo and does not show the actual unit for sale.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual keyboard in a real-world setting with a handwritten note of the current date.

risks.risk: Individual keys may be dead or have lost touch sensitivity.
risks.proof: A video of the seller playing a scale across the full range of the keyboard.

risks.risk: The LCD screen may have dead pixels or backlight issues not visible in a stock photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the actual unit's screen while powered on.

risks.risk: The power adapter shown in the graphic may be missing or a generic replacement.
risks.proof: A photo of the physical power adapter and its label.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual keyboard being sold, not a marketing graphic.
Video of the keyboard being played to confirm all keys and speakers work.
Photo of the serial number plate on the underside or back of the unit.
response.reason: The seller has provided a stock/promotional image rather than a photo of the actual item. It is impossible to assess the condition or even confirm the existence of the specific unit without real photos.
